provenance.instrument: Mount Joy Township Zoning Ordinance of 2012 (Chapter 135 Zoning, adopted by the Board of Supervisors 5-21-2012 by Ord. No. 279-2012, as amended), as published on eCode360
provenance.status_detail: eCode360 MO1487, Township of Mount Joy, Lancaster County (the chapter links the zoning map of Ord. No. 346-2024 on mtjoytwp.org, 135-32 'Authority' names the Elizabethtown Regional Sewer Authority, and 135-387 sends appeals to the Court of Common Pleas of Lancaster County). Not eCode360 MO1443 or mtjoytwp.us, which are Mount Joy Township, Adams County. District uses and figures are text in each district article. The only attachments are the zoning map and the table of map amendments. Floodplain rules are in Chapter 70 (Ord. No. 300-2016). New Laws: only Ord. No. 354-2026 (noise, Chapter 88)
provenance.code_current_through_note: eCode360 table of contents: 'Includes legislation through 03-16-2026.' New Laws: Ord. No. 354-2026 (8-17-2026, Nuisances: Noise, Ch 88) only
checks: Echo housing is a special exception in A, R, OS, R-1, R-2 and R-3 (135-83F, 135-63G, 135-73I, 135-93B, 135-103A, 135-113A). C-1, C-2, MU, LI, GI and IN do not list it

Echo housing is 'An additional dwelling unit created by the addition to or conversion of an existing principal dwelling or by the placement of a manufactured home on a property containing an existing dwelling, for occupancy by persons related by blood, marriage or adoption to the occupants of the principal dwelling' (135-32)

On a lot under two acres the unit must be an addition to the existing dwelling, at most 75% of the total livable floor area of the existing dwelling (first and second floors and basement, not attics), and designed to become part of the house when the use ends (135-225C)

On a lot of two acres or more the unit may be such an addition or a manufactured home installed on the lot. The manufactured home must meet the yard and setback requirements for a principal structure, but need not meet any separation from the house (135-225D)

Public water and sewer are used if available. Otherwise the unit shares the house's well and septic system unless the Sewage Enforcement Officer prohibits it, and an on-lot system must be shown to handle everyone or be expanded (135-225A)

The Zoning Hearing Board's decision is recorded at the applicant's cost. Only persons related by blood, marriage, adoption or foster relationship to the occupants of the house may live there, it may not be rented to others or subdivided, and a manufactured home must be removed when no longer so used (135-225F)
The echo unit is not counted as a dwelling unit or lot under the Agricultural District's limit on dwellings per parent tract. 135-225E refers to '§ 135-84', which is reserved. The quota is in 135-85B
Parking: one more space for the echo unit on top of the house's own. A dwelling unit with three bedrooms or fewer needs two (135-343A(1), (3))
Special exception standards: 135-383B. A special exception expires if no zoning permit is obtained within one year (135-383B(7))

A use 'not clearly permitted by right or as a special exception or by conditional use approval by this chapter within any zoning district' may be allowed by the Zoning Hearing Board as a special exception (135-7). Echo housing is permitted as a special exception in six districts, so 135-7 does not reach it in C-1, C-2, MU, LI, GI or IN

Conversion of a principal single-family detached dwelling into up to three dwelling units is a special exception in R-2 and R-3: 10,000 sq ft of lot per unit, interior changes only, public water and public sewer (135-103D, 135-113D, 135-224)

More than one principal use may be on a lot if the lot area equals the district minimums added together, each building meets the district rules and is placed so the lot can later be subdivided, with land development approval before the zoning permit (135-295). A second principal use in an existing building is a special exception (135-295D)

Unattached accessory buildings may be at most 20 ft tall in A, R, OS, R-1, R-2, R-3 and MU (135-86A, 135-66A, 135-76A, 135-96A, 135-106A, 135-116A, 135-146C). Their yards in A are 50 ft in front and 10 ft at the sides and rear. In R and OS they are 50 ft in front and 6 ft at the sides and rear. In R-1, R-2 and R-3 the front is the principal setback plus 15 ft, and 6 ft at the sides and rear. The echo manufactured home instead meets the principal yards (135-225D)

Principal buildings have no fixed height cap in A, R, OS, R-1, R-2 and R-3: above 35 ft each two feet of added height needs one more foot of side yard (135-65A, 135-75A, 135-85A, 135-95A, 135-105A, 135-115A)

Floodplain (Chapter 70): 'Within any identified floodplain area, any new construction or substantial improvements shall be prohibited' (70-42), and 'Within any identified floodplain area, manufactured homes shall be prohibited' (70-46). No new construction or development may be within 50 ft landward of the top of bank of any watercourse (70-41D). 70-62 lets an existing structure be improved by less than 50% of its market value if it causes no rise in the base flood elevation. Zoning also extends riparian corridors to take in 'at a minimum, the entire one-hundred-year floodplain' (135-306C), and the corridors 'shall be maintained free of any buildings or structures' (135-306A, B). So a detached echo unit is barred there, and an addition is barred unless it is an improvement 70-62 allows
A nonconforming lot in single and separate ownership may be developed for any use permitted in its district if it meets the setback, coverage, bulk and height rules (135-45)
Variances: 135-383C sets the usual findings and does not bar a use variance. The Board must require adequate water and sewage facilities

Village Design Option (135-353) in R-2 and R-3 developments of 10 acres or more: an 'Accessory apartment' may be in a portion of an accessory garage on up to 15% of the single-family detached lots, only on a lot designated for it at plan approval. At least 400 sq ft of habitable space, public water and sewer, and two off-street parking spaces per unit in addition. Accessory buildings in the VDO may be 25 ft tall (135-353E(2)(e), 135-353J(7)(b)). Not limited to relatives
On natural slopes over 20%, 40,000 sq ft of lot per principal building (135-305B)
A 25 ft buffer around wetlands (135-307)
Expansion of a dimensionally nonconforming structure follows 135-46
Required off-street parking may be reduced by special exception (135-343G)

term.note: 'An additional dwelling unit created by the addition to or conversion of an existing principal dwelling or by the placement of a manufactured home on a property containing an existing dwelling, for occupancy by persons related by blood, marriage or adoption to the occupants of the principal dwelling.'

status.note: A special exception from the Zoning Hearing Board. Only relatives of the occupants of the house (135-225F)

scope_districts.note: Echo housing is a listed special exception in these six districts

status_outside.note: C-1, C-2, MU, LI, GI and IN do not list echo housing

path.note: 'Echo housing in accordance with § 135-225' is listed among the special exception uses of each district. The Zoning Hearing Board decides under 135-383B

fallback_path.note: Zoning Hearing Board. The usual findings. No bar on a use variance

value.name: Conversion of a house into up to three units (R-2, R-3)
value.conditions: Conversion of a principal single-family detached dwelling into a multifamily dwelling of not more than three units (135-103D, 135-113D, 135-224). 'The lot area per dwelling unit, after the conversion, shall be a minimum of 10,000 square feet.' 'Only interior modifications shall be made to the existing principal building. No additions or extensions of such buildings shall be permitted.' The converted dwelling must use public water and public sewer. Parking per 135-343A(1), never on grass or another unpaved surface

requires.condition: An existing principal single-family detached dwelling is converted

value.note: 20,000 sq ft is 10,000 sq ft for each of two units. Not limited to relatives

value.name: Two-family dwelling (R-2, R-3)
value.conditions: 'Single-family semidetached dwellings or two-family dwellings' are permitted by right in R-2 and R-3 (135-102B, 135-112B). A two-family dwelling is 'A freestanding dwelling building containing two dwelling units for two families, arranged in a side-by-side or over-and-under configuration' (135-32). Lot 10,000 sq ft, width 50 ft for each dwelling unit, side yards 10 ft each over-and-under or 12 ft per unit side-by-side (135-105, 135-115)
value.note: A building of two units, not a unit added to a house. The code does not say how an existing house becomes a two-family dwelling

value.name: Second principal dwelling on the lot (135-295)
value.conditions: 'More than one principal use may be established on a single lot'. The lot area must equal the minimum lot areas of each use added together, each building must meet the district rules, and a second principal building must be placed so the lot can later be subdivided. 'The applicant shall obtain land development approval prior to obtaining a zoning permit' (135-295A to C). In A the parent tract dwelling quota still applies (135-85B)
value.note: Each figure is the district minimum for a single-family detached dwelling doubled (R-1 with public sewer, 80,000 sq ft without). Whether a second house is a second 'principal use' when the first is also a house is not settled. A second principal use in an existing building is a special exception instead (135-295D)

value.name: Manufactured home for farm laborers (any district, with a farm)
value.conditions: The Zoning Hearing Board may grant a special exception for a manufactured home used as temporary living quarters for farm laborers in any district, as an accessory to an approved principal agricultural use. At least one resident must work on that farm, the home is set back at least 60 ft from any street right-of-way and close to the farm buildings, and a farm worker must occupy it at least 30 days a year (135-300B)

requires.condition: An approved principal agricultural use on the lot, and a resident who works on the farm

value.note: Housing for farm workers, not a family unit. The rest of 135-300B was not read

value.name: Accessory apartment in a Village Design Option development (R-2, R-3)
value.conditions: The Village Design Option for R-2 and R-3 developments of 10 acres or more lists an 'Accessory apartment'. 'No more than 15%' of the single-family detached houses may have one, and 'only... on a lot that was designated for such use' when the plan was approved. At least 400 sq ft of habitable space, 'confined to a portion of an accessory garage', public water and public sewer, and 'Two off-street parking spaces per unit... in addition' to the house's. Accessory buildings in the VDO may be 25 ft tall (135-353J(7)(b))

requires.condition: The lot was designated for an accessory apartment when the Village Design Option plan was approved

value.note: Read from quoted text of 135-353. The 10 acres is the development tract. Not limited to relatives. Whether a lot outside a Village Design Option plan can use it is not settled, and the rest of 135-353 was not read

historic_bypass.note: No historic ADU path found. 135-309 (historic preservation) was not read

value.condition: Echo housing is added to an existing principal dwelling, or placed on a property containing an existing dwelling.
A manufactured home as the echo unit is allowed only on a property of two acres or more. On a smaller lot the unit must be an addition to the existing dwelling.

A detached echo unit must be a manufactured home installed on the lot. It meets the yard and setback requirements for a principal structure but need not meet a separation from the house, and it must be removed when relatives no longer live in it.
An addition must be designed so it can be used as part of the house when the echo housing use ends.

Public water and sewer must be used if available. Otherwise the unit shares the house's sewage and water systems unless the Sewage Enforcement Officer prohibits it, and an on-lot system must be shown to serve everyone or be expanded with the officer's review.

The Zoning Hearing Board's decision is recorded. It limits occupancy to persons related by blood, marriage, adoption or foster relationship to the occupants of the house, and bars renting to others or subdividing.
In an identified floodplain area, Chapter 70 prohibits any new construction and any manufactured home. A detached echo unit, which must be a manufactured home, may not be placed there.
The riparian corridor takes in at least the whole 100-year floodplain and must be kept free of any buildings or structures.

In an identified floodplain area, Chapter 70 prohibits new construction and substantial improvements, and no new construction or development may be within 50 ft landward of the top of bank of any watercourse. Zoning keeps the riparian corridor, which takes in the whole 100-year floodplain, free of buildings or structures.

disputed_by.note: An existing structure may be improved by less than 50% of its market value if the work causes no rise in the base flood elevation, so an addition within that limit may be allowed. Whether 135-306 reaches an addition to an existing house is not settled

types_allowed.note: 'the echo housing shall be an addition to the existing dwelling' (any lot) and, on two acres or more, 'the echo housing may be a manufactured home installed upon the lot'

types_in_conflict.note: The definition covers a unit created by 'conversion of an existing principal dwelling', but 135-225C and D allow only 'an addition to the existing dwelling' or a manufactured home

types_not_addressed.note: 135-225 names an addition or a manufactured home only. A unit in a garage or other accessory building is not named

max_sqft.note: No square foot cap. An addition is capped as a share of the house

max_share_by_form.note: 'Such addition shall not exceed 75% of the total livable floor area, to include first and second floors and basement but not attics, of the existing dwelling.' No cap for a manufactured home

internal_uses_district_height.note: An addition is part of the house, so the district rules apply

district_yards_bind_accessory.note: 'The manufactured home shall meet all yard and setback requirements from the property line required of a principal structure, but shall not be required to meet such separation requirements from the principal dwelling.'

accessory_structure_max_height_ft.note: The height cap for unattached accessory buildings in each district that lists echo housing

accessory_cap_binds_adu.note: 135-225D treats the echo manufactured home like a principal structure for yards, and says nothing of height. Whether the 20 ft accessory building height binds it is not settled

occupancy.value: Only persons related by blood, marriage, adoption or foster relationship to the occupants of the house. It may not be rented to anyone else.

owner_occupancy.note: No owner rule. The occupants must be related to the occupants of the principal dwelling

max_adus.note: 135-225 speaks of 'the echo housing' on a property. No number is stated

spaces_required.note: 'Echo housing shall be provided a minimum of one off-street parking space for the echo housing in addition to the off-street parking required for the principal dwelling.'

total_on_site.note: Two spaces for a dwelling unit with three bedrooms or fewer, three with four or more, plus one for the echo unit. So three for a house of up to three bedrooms

min_lot_sqft.note: One acre for each single-family detached dwelling. At most 2.5 acres (135-85C(2)), and the parent tract dwelling quota applies (135-85B). Width 100 ft, depth 150 ft

setback_front_ft.note: From the ultimate street right-of-way, for single-family detached dwellings

accessory_structure_max_height_ft.note: 'The maximum height shall be 20 feet, except that this restriction shall not be applicable to farm buildings and silos.' For unattached buildings for accessory use

min_lot_sqft.note: One acre. Width 100 ft, depth 150 ft

setback_front_ft.note: From the ultimate right-of-way, for single-family detached dwellings

accessory_structure_max_height_ft.note: 'The maximum height shall be 20 feet, except that this restriction shall not be applicable to farm buildings and silos.' For unattached buildings for accessory use

min_lot_sqft.note: Two acres, three acres if a principal building will be on natural slopes over 20%. Width 150 ft, depth 150 ft

setback_front_ft.note: From the ultimate right-of-way, for single-family detached buildings

accessory_structure_max_height_ft.note: 'The maximum height shall be 20 feet, except that this restriction shall not be applicable to farm buildings and silos.' For unattached buildings for accessory use

min_lot_sqft.note: 'The minimum lot area per dwelling unit which is served by public sanitary sewer shall be 20,000 square feet.' Width 90 ft, depth 135 ft

lot_area_per_unit_sqft.note: Lot area 'per dwelling unit'. Echo housing is 'An additional dwelling unit' (135-32). 135-225E exempts it only from the Agricultural District quota, so whether it needs its own lot area here is not settled

value.when: Not served by public sanitary sewer
value.note: 'The minimum lot area per dwelling unit which is not served by public sanitary sewer shall be 40,000 square feet.'

accessory_structure_max_height_ft.note: 'The maximum height shall be 20 feet, except that this restriction shall not be applicable to farm buildings and silos.' For unattached buildings for accessory use

min_lot_sqft.note: Single-family detached dwellings. 10,000 sq ft for semidetached or two-family dwellings. Width 75 ft, depth 125 ft. On development tracts of 10 acres or more the alternative figures of 135-105J may be used (8,500 sq ft lots)

setback_side_ft.note: Each side for single-family detached dwellings. A side-by-side semidetached or two-family dwelling has one side yard per unit of at least 12 ft (135-105F(2))

accessory_structure_max_height_ft.note: 'The maximum height shall be 20 feet, except that this restriction shall not be applicable to farm buildings and silos.' For unattached buildings for accessory use

min_lot_sqft.note: Single-family detached dwellings, and 10,000 sq ft for semidetached or two-family dwellings. Width 75 ft, depth 125 ft

setback_side_ft.note: Each side for single-family detached dwellings. A side-by-side semidetached or two-family dwelling has one side yard per unit of at least 12 ft (135-115F(2))

accessory_structure_max_height_ft.note: 'The maximum height shall be 20 feet, except that this restriction shall not be applicable to farm buildings and silos.' For unattached buildings for accessory use

min_lot_sqft.note: Single-family detached dwellings. 10,000 sq ft for semidetached dwellings. Width 75 ft, depth 125 ft

setback_front_ft.note: From the ultimate street right-of-way. Accessory buildings 15 ft more

setback_side_ft.note: Single-family detached dwellings. Accessory buildings 6 ft

max_impervious_coverage.note: Residential uses, 50% within a planned mixed-use development

min_lot_sqft.note: Single-family detached dwellings served by public sewer and water. Otherwise 40,000 sq ft per dwelling unit, or 20,000 sq ft with public sewer and no public water (135-165B(2)(a)). Width 75 ft (90 ft without public sewer and water), depth 125 ft
